i.norm: Verifies that {@code ofTaiSeconds} normalises a negative nanosecond adjustment by borrowing one second, and that two instants built from swapped (seconds, nanos) arguments are not considered equal.
Same pair of numbers, but passed in opposite order, so the two instants differ.
For secondInstant: a nano adjustment of -3113 borrows a whole second, so the second drops from -1192 to -1193 and the nanos wrap to 1e9 - 3113.
